notes.title: Update ver1.07 beta supported Leaderboards.
notes.content:
If you beat this game, you can upload record with Y button.
(you need to buy RECORD in SYEGA SHOP)

you can check Leaderboards in Community tab.
URL -> http://steamcommunity.com/stats/420770/leaderboards/1098413/


If a serious problem occurs, We could reset the ranking.

notes.title: Update ver1.03 for Full Screen and boot error
notes.content:
Ver1.03 Changes 
- Fixed boot error where the game would not start despite minimum specs being met.
- Fixed  screen flickering issue. 
- Fixed processing error where the game would run slower than intended (60 fps). 
- Supports full screen.
